# p10k-rs v0.1.4 — DRAFT

> Status: **draft** — pending Sean's review. Replace this banner and
> tag when ready. The release workflow fires on `git push origin v0.1.4`.

Render-layer Unicode safety, transient prompt modes wired honestly,
truecolor hex literals, and two more user-facing config surfaces.
The v0.1.3 → v0.1.4 cycle closes 4 of the 5 sprint-deferred v0.2
items (T1.8, T1.10, T1.11, T1.24) and three test-harness env-races
caught while shipping. Only T0.5 (sha256-pin gitstatusd) remains
deferred.

**Test count:** 505 passing, 3 ignored (368 at v0.1.3).
**Slice count:** 10 commits since the v0.1.3 tag.
**Theme:** "transient hardening + render-layer Unicode safety + truecolor ergonomics."

## What you'll notice (visible changes)

### Transient prompt modes actually work now

The four-mode `transient_prompt` setting (`off` / `always` /
`same-dir` / `unique-dir`) has been in the schema since v0.1.1,
but until this release all three non-off modes collapsed
unconditionally. T1.8 ships the real behaviour:

```toml
# ~/.config/p10k-rs/config.toml
transient_prompt = "same-dir"
```

- `off` — never collapse. Byte-identical to pre-T1.8 (the previous
  default).
- `always` — collapse every prompt to `❯`.
- `same-dir` — collapse only when this prompt's cwd matches the
  prompt above it. If you `cd` then run a command, the prompt
  *above* the `cd` keeps its full ribbon in scrollback.
- `unique-dir` — aliased to `same-dir` for now. The full
  history-aware "collapse all but the most recent prompt per
  directory" semantic lands in a follow-up slice. The variant is
  preserved in the schema so opting in today doesn't break later.

Implementation note for anyone reading the zsh init: the binary
now exits 2 (instead of stdout-empty) to signal "leave PROMPT
alone." The widget respects it.

### `marker_foreground` per-segment field

The status markers `* ! + ~ ? ≡` on the `vcs` segment have been
hardcoded red since v0.1.0. Slice 59 makes them configurable:

```toml
[segment.vcs]
marker_foreground = "yellow"   # or any colour the schema accepts
```

Absent → red preserved. Opt-in only; existing configs unchanged.

### `[ai]` config: `model` + `context_tokens`

Two new opt-in TOML fields on the `[ai]` block:

```toml
[ai]
model = "claude-opus-4-7"
context_tokens = 200000
```

Schema-only this release — the AI statusline render path is still
a stub (`p10k-rs statusline --host …` returns nothing). When the
per-host metadata story lands these fields are the data plane.

### Truecolor hex literals in config

Three input shapes now produce a truecolor SGR; pick whichever
reads best:

```toml
[segment.dir]
foreground = "#ff6600"     # T1.24 — full hex literal
# foreground = "#f60"      # T1.24 — CSS-shorthand (expands to #ff6600)
# foreground = [255, 102, 0]  # array form (works since slice 25-era)
```

The truecolor emission path was already there; the user-facing
ergonomic form is the new bit. Set `colors = "true-color"` (or
leave on `follow-terminal` and let the OSC 4 probe decide) for
the binary to actually emit the 24-bit SGR; `ansi-256` mode
quantises the RGB triple to the nearest 256-cube cell, and
`ansi-8` falls back to the closest 3-bit cube.

Strings starting with `#` MUST be valid 3- or 6-digit hex —
`"#xyz"` and `"#fffe"` are parse errors, not silent fallback to
`Color::Named`. A `#`-prefixed string that doesn't parse is
overwhelmingly a typo.

### jj prompts show divergent + conflicts

Jujutsu users who had `divergent` or `conflicts` set on a change
were quietly missing both indicators — the render side was wired
in v0.1.1 (slice 52) but the parser was leaving them at default.
Slice 62 closes the gap. No config change needed.

## What you won't notice (but matters)

### Unicode-class render-path hardening (T1.10)

`SafeText` — the type-system chokepoint that every byte off the
daemon wire / git stdout / jj stdout / per-segment env probe
flows through — now strips a wider class of Unicode hazards:

- BiDi controls (`U+202A`–`U+202E`, `U+2066`–`U+2069`).
- Zero-width joiners and non-joiners (`U+200B`–`U+200F`).
- Format characters and deprecated tag characters.

It also normalises to NFC and truncates on grapheme-cluster
boundaries via the new `from_untrusted_with_cap(s, cap)`
constructor. A branch name like `<RLO>scam<PDF>main` is now
unconditionally re-expressed in its visible form before reaching
your prompt. Trojan-source-style attacks via repository content
are off the table.

### E2E `SafeText` on ten more segments (T1.11)

The segment helpers that read user-controlled env vars and
filesystem state used to return `Option<String>` — the
sanitisation happened just before render, by convention. T1.11
hoists the type-system invariant to the helper boundary itself:
`anaconda`, `aws`, `docker_context`, `fnm`, `kubecontext`,
`nodenv`, `pixi`, `pyenv`, `terraform`, `virtualenv` now return
`Option<SafeText>`. `SafeText: Display` keeps the existing
`format!` callsites identical; the win is that "this value is
sanitised" is now load-bearing at the type level.

### Three test-harness env-races fixed

Three previously-intermittent test failures in
`p10k-rs-config`, `p10k-rs-git::gitstatusd`, and
`p10k-rs-core::term_caps` were caused by parallel `cargo test`
threads colliding on `std::env::set_var`. All three are now
serialised under module-level `Mutex<()>`. A new project
invariant — any test that mutates env vars must acquire the
module lock — is documented in `STATE.md`.

## How to verify (unchanged from v0.1.3)

Same recipe as v0.1.3 — every tarball ships with a sigstore
keyless signature plus SLSA build-provenance attestation.

```bash
# 1. Download the tarball + its .cosign.bundle from the GitHub release.
# 2. Verify the signature:
cosign verify-blob \
  --bundle p10k-rs-v0.1.4-<triple>.tar.gz.cosign.bundle \
  --certificate-identity-regexp \
    'https://github.com/scurran1986/powerlevel10k-rs/\.github/workflows/release\.ya?ml@refs/tags/v0\.1\.4' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer 'https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com' \
  p10k-rs-v0.1.4-<triple>.tar.gz

# 3. Verify the build provenance:
gh attestation verify p10k-rs-v0.1.4-<triple>.tar.gz \
  --owner scurran1986
```

Both must succeed before installing. See `SECURITY.md` for the
full verification story.

## Migration

No breaking changes. Every new field is opt-in. `Off`-mode
transient behaviour is byte-identical to pre-T1.8.

If you were relying on the `transient_prompt = "same-dir"` /
`"unique-dir"` setting *expecting* it to act like `always` (it
silently did until T1.8), you'll now see the real same-dir
semantic: prompts above a `cd` keep their full ribbon in
scrollback. Set `transient_prompt = "always"` if you want the
old aliased behaviour.

## Deferred to v0.2 (still open)

- **T0.5** — sha256-pin gitstatusd binary at install. Today's
  install.sh symlinks a `brew` / `apt`-installed gitstatusd;
  pinning means switching to a download-and-verify model, which
  is its own release cycle.
- **T1.8 follow-up** — real `UniqueDir` history semantics
  (cross-prompt cwd history; today aliased to `SameDir`).
- **Slice 61 follow-up** — wire `[ai]` `model` / `context_tokens`
  into the statusline render path (Claude Code / Cursor / Aider
  host protocol needs confirmation first).
